hilla.against: Lewis & Short has only the plural hillae
hilla.html: Lewis & Short: hillae, small intestines, also a kind of smoked sausage (Hor. S. 2.4.60); the singular is Traupman’s.

sources: Lewis & Short: hillae
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 71, 329.
